style.backgroundSystem: deep charcoal gradient #33363B for dramatic hero and feature shots, clean white #FFFFFF for infographic and spec shots, light grey #E4E4E4 for split panels
style.iconSystem: thin-line and solid geometric icons, single signal-yellow accent, consistent rounded rectangular labels
style.lightingSystem: neutral-cool studio lighting; soft rim highlights with controlled reflections on dark backgrounds, bright even high-key with soft contact shadows on white backgrounds
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium automotive-tech ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep charcoal gradient #33363B, clean white #FFFFFF, one vivid signal-yellow accent #F7C600 and dark grey text #2D2D2D, with light grey #E4E4E4 as a panel and split-screen fill; neutral-cool studio lighting with soft rim highlights on dark backgrounds and bright even high-key light with soft contact shadows on white backgrounds; modern geometric sans-serif type; consistent rounded rectangular info labels and simple geometric icons; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and consistent scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent product scale across the set; product centered or anchored to one column, each screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
style.surfaceSystem: smooth seamless gradient backdrop and matte light-grey panel #E4E4E4, no texture clutter
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif type; headlines in charcoal #2D2D2D on light panels and #FFFFFF on dark panels, with thin-line labels in signal yellow #F7C600; light grey #E4E4E4 kept as a panel and split-screen fill
